pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with rounded vertices and soft pixel-level gradients at the edges. The patches exhibit greater spatial area on the mid-flank and neck compared to the smaller, more densely packed regions on the visible lower limb.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored pathways separating the patches. The topology features clear junction nodes with predominantly tri-radial intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the central flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible as a dark, linear silhouette along the upper neck with low-amplitude, high-frequency irregular serrations against the desaturated background.

other_distinctive_markers: Linear foreground occlusions caused by out-of-focus vegetation crossing the lower-left section of the flank.
